verdict.rationale: The pack only glancingly supports this story: a community report confirms Slack has private channels as a distinct conversation type (slack-comm-2). A help-page keyword list includes "channels", "channel management" and "Add members" (slack-intdir-9), and the MCP docs reference sending to "any type of conversation" (slack-docs-29). Missing for 10: first-party documentation of creating public vs. private channels, admin membership controls (invite/remove, posting permissions, conversion between public and private), and hands-on corroboration of admin channel management.
